title: Two-step equations: run the number machine backwards
examples: Why do you undo the last step first?

explain.say: Here is a number machine. You put in a mystery number, x. Look at the first box. The machine multiplies by 3, then adds 4, and out comes 19. So 3x plus 4 equals 19. What did you put in?

draw.text: Two-step equations: run the number machine backwards

explain.say: To find x, run the machine backwards. Undo the last step first, like taking off your shoes before your socks. The last step was add 4, so take away 4.

stages.label: Take away 4
stages.ask: Why do you undo the last step first?

stages.label: x is 5
stages.ask: How do you check the answer?

explain.say: Watch the number line. Start at 19 and hop 4 to the left. You land on 15. So before the machine added 4, it had 15. Now what undoes times 3?
Divide by 3! Share 15 into 3 equal groups. Look: 5 in each group. So x is 5.

You cracked it! Check: 5 times 3 is 15, plus 4 is 19. Perfect. Wow: computers undo steps in reverse order like this all the time. Challenge: a machine doubles x, then takes away 3, and out comes 11. What is x?

faq.a: It is a picture of steps done to a number in order. A number goes in, each box changes it, and a new number comes out.

faq.q: Why do you undo the last step first?
faq.a: Going backwards means reversing the order. The last thing done to x must be the first thing you undo, like taking off shoes before socks.
asks: Which step do you undo first?

faq.q: How do you check the answer?
faq.a: Put your answer back in the start of the machine. If x is 5, then 5 times 3 is 15 and plus 4 is 19, which matches.
asks: How do I check my equation answer?

faq.q: How do you solve 2x minus 3 equals 11?
faq.a: Undo the take away 3 by adding 3 to get 14. Then undo the doubling by halving. x is 7.

faq.q: What is the inverse of each operation?
faq.a: Adding and subtracting undo each other. Multiplying and dividing undo each other. These pairs are called inverse operations.

facts: Addition and subtraction are inverse operations, and so are multiplication and division.
To solve 3x + 4 = 19, undo the steps in reverse order: subtract 4, then divide by 3.

quiz.why: Take away 1 to get 20, then divide by 4 to get 5.

wrong.1: 5.5 divides first and then takes away, the wrong order.
wrong.2: 20 is 4x. You still need to divide by 4.

quiz.say: In 3x minus 2 equals 10, what do you do first?
quiz.why: The last step done to x was take away 2, so undo it first by adding 2.

wrong.1: Dividing first would also split the 2, which makes it harder.
wrong.2: Taking away 2 does the same step again instead of undoing it.
